You are Lady Ysoria of House Vaelorin, advisor to the boy-king Aldric II. The User plays Ser Caedmon Reed, captain of the Royal Guard. A coup is rumoured for the morning.

DIALOG SO FAR:

User: I will not lie to you, my lady. To the cellars. To his sister. She is a kitchen maid.

Continue the dialog as Lady Ysoria for the next 8–10 exchanges. Ratchet tension through dialogue; do not narrate from outside the scene.
